seoTitle: Instahyre Jobs Scraper - Experience, Skills & Dates
seoDescription: Scrape Instahyre jobs by skill, city and experience, newest first: posting date, experience range, skills, headcount and stipend. No login or API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, measured on Apify on 2026-11-08: the example input took 215 s at 512 MB (0.030 CU), 207 s at 1,024 MB (0.057 CU) and 134 s at 2,048 MB (0.075 CU; its walk read 40 fewer job numbers). Every run peaked at 62 to 107 MB with about 1% CPU: runs wait on Instahyre's limits (20 searches a minute, about 1.5 job answers a second), so more memory costs more per run and buys no speed. Timeout 3600 s: the 500-job run took 970 s.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: First pricing: measured cost plus a 100-150% markup by tier

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, city, experience range, skills, job category, posting date, link, and the company's headcount and founding year. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, and the company's industry, website, LinkedIn, tech stack, benefits and Glassdoor ratings when Instahyre shows them.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.013 at the default 512 MB. It covers what a run costs before its first job, such as finding Instahyre's newest job or reading its search.
